name: FURRY HITLER
source:
Set in mid 1950th, towards the end of WWII in an imagery furry world, this story is told from Adolf's perspective.
Seeing the ruins of his cities and a sad state the whole country is in,
he looks back at some of the decisions that were made during the war.
In each particular case, you will have a choice to make.
Choose well and remember that your decision affects outcome of the war.​

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1992370/FURRY_HITLER/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这个故事以1950年代中期、二战即将结束时的毛茸茸世界为背景，从阿道夫的角度讲述。
看到他的城市的废墟和整个国家的悲惨状况，
他回顾了战争期间做出的一些决定。
在每种特定情况下，你都需要做出选择。
好好选择，记住你的决定会影响战争的结果。​

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1992370/FURRY_HITLER/]Steam[/url]]
